description: Randomize a COMP's numeric custom parameters within their slider ranges — an instant new variation for live improvisation. `amount` blends toward random (1 = fully random, low values nudge the current look). Non-numeric controls (toggles, menus) are left untouched, so it is always safe to fire. Pair with manage_presets/manage_cue to snapshot a happy accident.

amount.description: How far to move toward a random value in range: 1 = fully random, 0.2 = a gentle nudge from the current value. Lets you improvise without losing the current look.

comp_path.description: COMP whose custom parameters to randomize (usually a control-panel container).

params.description: Specific custom-parameter names to randomize. Defaults to every numeric one.

seed.description: Optional RNG seed for repeatable results.

name: randomize_controls
title: Randomize controls
